responsibility: This file lowers Modula-2 exception constructs onto GCC’s exception-handling and C++ ABI runtime trees. It initializes the required __cxa_* helper declarations and EH type metadata, then builds THROW_EXPR, TRY_BLOCK, HANDLER, and TRY_FINALLY_EXPR structures together with begin/end catch runtime calls, so gm2 can express throw/try/catch semantics using GCC’s generic EH infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2except API: it contains the GCC tree-building logic and C++ EH runtime bindings such as __cxa_throw/__cxa_begin_catch setup, whereas m2except.h only declares the C entry points and m2except.def exposes the same surface to Modula-2 code.
